title: Insert Into a Binary Search Tree
summary: Follow the BST search path, insert element e, and observe the resulting tree height h.

input.hint: JSON object: { tree: level-order BST, e: integer to insert }

visual.representation: BST with search-path highlighting, inserted-node highlight, per-node subtree height, and final overall height h.

approach.explanation: Compare e with each node and follow left for smaller values or right for larger values until an empty child is found. Duplicate values are ignored. Height h is the number of nodes on the longest root-to-leaf path; an empty tree has height 0.
